scope: ARWP Technical SEO Critic TSC-01 through TSC-09 applied after the existing Search Release and final public-surface gates.

findings.evidence: scripts/check-technical-seo-critic.mjs inspects the final sitemap cohort and rejects invalid top-level elements inside the effective head.
The Site Focus contract declares LCP/INP/CLS budgets, but repository or Lighthouse data is not relabelled as field Core Web Vitals. Provider field evidence remains required.
No current pagination URL family or page= implementation was observed in the reviewed source/sitemap architecture. The critic gate still rejects obsolete rel=next/prev metadata.

The final-artifact critic counts discoverable same-origin query-bearing links and surfaces them as crawl-state review evidence; current source review found no page= or href query family requiring a production fix.
scripts/check-live-technical-seo-critic.mjs records ETag/Last-Modified presence and bounded conditional 304 behavior without treating missing validators as a ranking failure.
The final sitemap cohort is checked for accidental nofollow on same-origin internal discovery links.
The final artifact rejects meta keywords, rel=next/prev and nositelinkssearchbox. html[lang] remains semantic/accessibility metadata rather than a claimed Google language-detection signal.
The live critic compares an HTTP Link rel=canonical target, when present, with the HTML canonical on a bounded sitemap cohort.
Sitemap pages are rejected for unintended negative robots/googlebot directives in HTML and negative X-Robots-Tag restrictions are checked after deployment.
